title: Ivanti Avalanche SecureFilter allowPassThrough Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to partially bypass authentication on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the allowPassThrough method. The issue results from incorrect string matching when making an authorization decision. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to partially bypass authentication on the application.
